REELSHORT- “Mi amor secreto es su hermano” (“Obra Audiovisual”)

 

 

1. ARTIST’S SERVICES: Artist shall render all services customarily rendered by actors in moving picture projects and at all times promptly comply with Company’s reasonable instructions, subject to the Production Schedule (See Exhibit A.) Artist shall render services in connection with wardrobe preparation and fitting, tests, auditions, rehearsals, pre-recordings, pre-shoots, consultations, and similar pre-production matters (collectively, “Works”). Photography shall be exclusive and rendered consecutively until the completion thereof. If Company requires further services of Actor for retakes, added scenes, looping, post-synching and other post-production services following completion of principal photography (collectively, “Post-Production Services”), public interviews, press junkets, premieres, personal appearances, still photography and similar matters (collectively, “Promotional Activities”), Actor shall render such services subject to Actor’s professional availability, and the corresponding fees, workdays and conditions shall be set by mutual written agreement of the Parties.

 

2. RIGHTS:

1) Artist hereby acknowledges that all the results and proceeds of Artist’s services produced for the Picture hereunder are owned by the Company or Company’s assignee. Company shall have the right to use Artist’s name and likeness with respect to distribution and exploitation of the Picture. Company may make such use of the Picture and distribution of the Picture as Company, in its sole discretion, shall deem appropriate.

 

2) Artist hereby irrevocably grants to Company, its successors and assigns, of all of Artist’s rights, title, and interest of any kind and nature, in and to the Picture, including, without limitation, all copyrights in connection therewith and all tangible and intangible properties with respect to the Picture, throughout the Universe and in Perpetuity.

3) In addition, and notwithstanding the above provisions, Company grants Artist a license to use the Picture created under this Agreement solely for the promotion of the Artist and/or its principals and for demonstration purposes in connection with the public promotion and/or advertising of Artist. This provision shall only apply after an email confirmation between Company and Artist of the first public distribution of the Picture.

 

 

3.TERM:

1) This Agreement shall be effective for the period commencing on Parties’ execution of this Agreement and will continue in effect until acceptance and approval (which shall not be unreasonably withheld) by Company of all the Deliverable Items described in Exhibit A (“Term”) unless sooner terminated as provided herein.

2) Any additional work must be separately negotiated for in good faith. Company shall not be liable for payment for any such additional work performed until it has executed a separate agreement for such work in writing.

3) The Company may terminate this Agreement at any time prior to the start of principal photography, for production, organizational, or artistic reasons, and such termination shall not constitute a breach of contract. In such event, the Company shall pay the Artist the fees corresponding to the tasks actually performed and any previously authorized expenses up to the date on which the termination is communicated, and both Parties shall be released from any further obligation or claim.

4. FEES:

1) If Artist is not in material breach of this Agreement, subject to any other applicable terms and conditions, Artist shall receive the renumeration specified in Exhibit A;

 

2) Payment will be made in pursuant to the date set forth in Exhibit A in accordance with the Company’s standard payment policy for the Picture (unless otherwise specified therein): (i) after Company’s timely receipt of a Work that complies with this Agreement; or (ii) prorated to the days worked in the case of a Work that is incomplete due to any reason

 

5. CREDIT: Company shall accord credit to Artist 1) on screen; 2) in paid advertisements and in other materials, Project Manual, Press Kits for the Picture wherever the writer(s), director(s), and/or producer(s) of the Picture.

 

6. PUBLICITY: Artist shall not furnish any information or publicity about the Picture, the Picture’s budget, the Compensation, or Company to any third party.

7. PROMOTIONAL OBLIGATIONS

Artist acknowledges and agrees that promotional and publicity activities constitute an integral part of the Services to be rendered under this Agreement. Accordingly, Artist shall reasonably cooperate with Company's promotional and marketing activities relating to the Picture during its production, release and launch, including the publication of organic promotional content on Artist's primary social media account(s) when reasonably requested by Company.

Furthermore, Artist agrees and undertakes to publish at least one (1) promotional post regarding the Picture on Artist's primary social media account(s) in connection with the official release of the Picture, on the date or within the period reasonably designated by Company.

Artist further acknowledges and agrees that all promotional obligations set forth herein are included within the compensation payable under this Agreement and shall not entitle Artist to any additional compensation, fee, reimbursement or payment of any kind.

8. NON-DISCLOSURE, CONFIDENTIALITY AND PROPRIETARY AGREEMENT:

1) The term “Confidential Information” means any information or material which is proprietary to the Company, whether or not owned or developed by the Company, which is not generally known other than by the Company, and which the Artist may obtain through any direct or indirect contact with the Company. Regardless of whether specifically identified as confidential or proprietary, Confidential Information shall include any information provided by the Company concerning the Picture and the production of the Picture and any third party with which the Company deals, including, without limitation, business records and plans, trade secrets, financial information, pricing structure, discounts, contracts, copyrights, and intellectual property.

 

2)The term “Proprietary Information” means information or material a) Proprietary to the Company or b) designated as confidential by the Company or 3) not known generally to the public which the Artist may obtain through any direct or indirect contact with the Company. The Proprietary Information includes without limitation the following types of information and other information of a similar nature (whether tangible or intangible and whether or not reduced to a writing): any and all information relating to the Picture and its production and exploitation, including without limitation any and all information relating to the short screenplay and treatment, feature screenplay and treatment, budget, schedule, plans, drawings, designs, specifications, ideas, concepts, models, costumes, techniques or special effects for the Picture or other creative, business and/or physical production elements relating to the Picture.

 

 

3) Artist understands that it is an essential term of such engagement that Confidential/Proprietary Information be maintained in the strictest confidence. Accordingly, Artist agrees that unless and until Artist is expressly authorized to do so by the Company or its authorized representative(s) in writing, Artist shall: a) Keep all Confidential/Proprietary Information (whether relating to Artist’s services or otherwise learned by Artist) in strictest confidence; b) Not reproduce or duplicate any Confidential/Proprietary Information (unless required to render services and then only the minimum so required); c) Return any Confidential/Proprietary Information in Artist’s possession (and erase any Confidential/Proprietary Information duplicated to Artist’s hard drive or digitally stored and provide certification of such actions) upon request therefore by the Company; d) Not disclose, report, reveal, gossip or speculate about, assign, sell or transfer, either directly or indirectly, by any means including without limitation by email, blogging, Instagram or tweeting, any Confidential/Proprietary Information to any person or company with the exception of other persons performing services on the Picture, but then only if and to the extent necessary in order for them to perform such services or evaluate a possible transaction (collectively, “Authorized Personnel”), subject to informing such Authorized Personnel of the confidentiality requirements with respect to the Confidential/Proprietary Information and arranging for their prior signature of a copy of this Agreement.

 

 

9. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES: Artist represents and warrants that he/she is free to enter into this Agreement and will not do or permit any act which will interfere with or derogate from the full performance of Artist’s services or Company’s exercise of the Rights.

 

10. ALCOHOL/DRUGS: There will be no use of alcohol or drugs while services are being rendered.    


11. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS:

1) No additional services or overtime shall be paid without the prior written approval of Manager. Artist shall not be paid for holidays and idle days not worked. Time reports must reflect hours actually worked and be submitted before the time designated by the Line Producer.

2) Artist acknowledges that the Works contemplated to be rendered by Artist are not subject to any guild or union collective bargaining agreement. Accordingly, without limiting the general of the foregoing, Artist agrees that in no event will Artist be entitled to any payment for any use or reuse of the Picture or any part thereof and/or any rights therein.

3) The agreed remuneration to the Artist will be paid by ACH and subject to applicable tax withholdings, if any.


4) Artist agrees that any personal vehicle used in connection with Artist’s Works will be used under Artist’s direction and control. Artist is solely responsible for any damage to or loss of such vehicle and hereby waives any claims against the Company for any loss or damage of any kind. Company shall have no obligation to indemnify Artist against any losses or damages, or to provide any insurance coverage for the benefit of Artist covering the vehicle herein described. Artist understands that prior to driving, Artist is required to have a valid driver’s license and carry at least a third-party liability insurance. Artist must have, if applicable, a current insurance for the term of the Agreement, which covers any type of damage, loss, accident and/or theft of its material and/or work tools.

5) The Company will have production insurance against accidents, civil liability, among others. Consequently, in the event that the material and/or tools are not covered by the insurance policy. issued by the Artist, Company may respond, without being obliged to do so and provided that the insurance company accepts, to file the claim for the same, being limited only to the coverage of the policy contracted by the Company. If, after investigation, that the parties determined that the Artist is at fault for the loss, damage, accident and/or theft of its material and/or work tools, Artist agrees to pay the deductible of said loss, damage, accident, and/or theft. Likewise, the Parties agree that in the event that the Artist suffers an accident at any location or any other place of provision of the Work, not caused by the Artist or by any of the other Artist, Company will be responsible for paying the expenses caused, only up to the amount that the insurance policy issued allows and in accordance with the terms and conditions established in said insurance. Therefore, the Artist, in this act releases the Company from any claim and/or liability that this may cause.

 

 

 

6) Artist is prohibited from working for another production company during the hours set forth in Exhibit A. Any deviations require the prior written approval from Company. Violations of this policy will result in the termination of this Agreement.

 

7) Artist acknowledges that Company has a strict policy prohibiting the use of alcohol or controlled substances during or immediately before work hours and that failure to adhere to this and other work rules could result in immediate termination of this Agreement.

 

12. MISCELLANEOUS:

1) Indemnification: Artist shall indemnify and defend Company from and against any and all claims and damages arising from the breach of any representation or warranty of Artist hereunder to the extent such claim or damage does not arise out of a breach by Company hereunder.

 

 

2) Arbitration: Artist and Company agree to meet and confer in good faith to resolve any problems or disputes that may arise under this Agreement. Any controversy, dispute or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement or the breach thereof, including any question regarding its interpretation, existence, validity or termination, shall be resolved by arbitration in accordance with this Provision 10.2); provided, however, that the following shall not be subject to arbitration: a legal proceeding brought by a third party against Artist or Company, or any crossclaim or third party claim brought by a third party against Artist or Company. Negotiation shall be a condition precedent to the filing of any arbitration demand by either party, or no arbitration demand may be filed until the exhaustion of Company’s internal appeal procedures. In the event arbitration between Artist or Company becomes necessary, such arbitration shall be initiated by either party making a written demand for arbitration on the other party. The arbitration shall be conducted in state courts located in the City and County of Los Angeles. The arbitration shall be conducted in accordance with the internal laws of the State of California without giving effect to any choice or conflict of law provision or rule. The parties expressly agree to be bound by the decision of the arbitrator(s). The parties further agree that the prevailing, or substantially prevailing, party’s costs of arbitration are to be borne in equal shares by the other party. Notwithstanding this agreement to arbitrate, Artist or Company may seek interim and/or permanent injunctive relief pursuant to this Agreement in any state courts located in the city and County of Los Angeles of competent jurisdiction.

 

3) Severability: If any provision of this Agreement is found to be illegal, invalid, unconscionable, or unenforceable under present or future laws effective during the term hereof, such provision shall be fully severable. This Agreement is to be construed and enforced as if such illegal, invalid, unconscionable, or unenforceable provision had never comprised a part hereof. The remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect unaffected by such severance, provided that the invalid provision is not material to the overall purpose and operation of this Agreement.

4) Governing Law: This Agreement shall be construed and governed under the laws of the State of California. Any and all claims or actions that might arise in any way in connection with or out of this Agreement shall be brought only in the courts located in Los Angeles County, California, and the parties hereby expressly waive any objection they would otherwise have to venue or jurisdiction in said courts.

5) Amendment: The provisions of this Agreement may be amended or waived only by the written agreement of Company and Artist, and no course of conduct or failure or delay in enforcing the provisions of this Agreement shall affect the validity, binding effect or enforceability of this Agreement.

 

6)Waiver: The waiver by either party of any breach of any provision of this Agreement or warranty representation herein set forth is not to be construed as a waiver of any subsequent breach of the same or any other provision. The failure to exercise any right hereunder shall not operate as a waiver of such right. All rights and remedies provided herein are cumulative.

 

7) Counterparts: This Agreement shall be executed by an authorized representative of each party and may be executed in multiple copies. Each copy shall be deemed an original, but all copies together shall constitute one and the same instrument.

SERVICIOS DEL ARTISTA: El artista prestará todos los servicios que suelen prestar los actores en proyectos audiovisuales y cumplirá en todo momento y sin demora las instrucciones razonables de la empresa, con sujeción al calendario de producción (véase el anexo A). El rodaje será exclusivo y se llevará a cabo de manera consecutiva hasta su finalización. Si la empresa requiriera servicios adicionales del Actor para nuevas tomas, escenas añadidas, doblaje/looping, postsincronización y demás servicios de posproducción (conjuntamente, los “Servicios de Posproducción”), así como entrevistas públicas, press junkets, estrenos, apariciones personales, fotografía fija y asuntos similares (conjuntamente, las “Actividades Promocionales”), el Actor prestará tales servicios sujeto a su disponibilidad profesional, y los honorarios, jornadas y condiciones correspondientes serán fijados de común acuerdo por las Partes por escrito.

 DERECHOS:

1) El Artista reconoce por la presente que todos los resultados y ganancias de los servicios prestados por el Artista para la Obra Audiovisual  en virtud del presente contrato son propiedad de la Empresa o del cesionario de la Empresa. La Empresa tendrá derecho a utilizar el nombre y la imagen del Artista en relación con la distribución y explotación de la Obra Audiovisual . La Empresa podrá hacer uso de la Obra Audiovisual  y distribuirla como considere oportuno, a su entera discreción.

2) El Artista cede irrevocablemente a la Empresa, sus sucesores y cesionarios, todos los derechos, títulos e intereses de cualquier tipo y naturaleza del Artista sobre la Obra Audiovisual, incluyendo, sin limitación, todos los derechos de autor relacionados con la misma y todas las propiedades tangibles e intangibles con respecto a la Obra Audiovisual, en todo el Universo y a perpetuidad.

3) Además, y sin perjuicio de las disposiciones anteriores, la Empresa concede al Artista una licencia para utilizar la Obra Audiovisual creada en virtud del presente Contrato únicamente con fines promocionales del Artista y/o sus mandantes y con fines de demostración en relación con la promoción pública y/o la publicidad del Artista. Esta disposición solo se aplicará tras la confirmación por correo electrónico entre la Empresa y el Artista de la primera distribución pública de la Obra Audiovisual.

 

3. PLAZO:

1) El presente Acuerdo entrará en vigor en el momento de su firma por las Partes y permanecerá vigente hasta que la Empresa haya aceptado y aprobado (sin demoras injustificadas) todos los Elementos Entregables descritos en el Anexo A («Plazo»), salvo que se rescinda antes de lo previsto en el presente documento.

2) Cualquier trabajo adicional deberá negociarse por separado de buena fe. La Empresa no será responsable del pago de ningún trabajo adicional realizado hasta que haya firmado un acuerdo por separado por escrito para dicho trabajo.

3) La Empresa podrá dar por finalizado el presente Contrato en cualquier momento previo al inicio del rodaje, por motivos de producción, reorganización o decisión artística, sin que ello constituya incumplimiento contractual. En tal caso, La Empresa abonará al Artista los honorarios correspondientes a las tareas efectivamente realizadas y los gastos previamente autorizados hasta la fecha en que se comunique la terminación, quedando ambas Partes liberadas de toda otra obligación o reclamo.

4. HONORARIOS:

1) Si el Artista no incumple de manera sustancial el presente Contrato, y con sujeción a cualquier otro término y condición aplicable, el Artista recibirá la remuneración especificada en el Anexo A.

2) El pago se realizará de conformidad con la fecha establecida en el Anexo A, de acuerdo con la política de pago estándar de la Empresa para la Obra Audiovisual (salvo que se especifique lo contrario en la misma): (i) tras la recepción oportuna por parte de la Empresa de un Trabajo que cumpla con el presente Contrato; o (ii) prorrateado en función de los días trabajados en el caso de un Trabajo que esté incompleto por cualquier motivo.


5. CRÉDITO: La empresa otorgará crédito al Artista 1) en pantalla; 2) en anuncios pagados y en otros materiales, manual del proyecto, dossiers de prensa de la obra audiovisual, siempre que se otorgue crédito al guionista, director y/o productor de la Obra Audiovisual.

6. PUBLICIDAD: El artista no proporcionará ninguna información ni publicidad sobre la Obra Audiovisual, el presupuesto de la Obra Audiovisual, la Compensación o la empresa a terceros.

7. OBLIGACIONES PROMOCIONALES

El Artista reconoce y acepta que las actividades promocionales y de difusión constituyen parte integrante de los Servicios objeto del presente Contrato. En consecuencia, el Artista deberá colaborar razonablemente con las actividades de promoción y marketing de la Obra Audiovisual durante su período de producción, lanzamiento y estreno, incluyendo la realización de acciones promocionales orgánicas en sus cuentas principales de redes sociales cuando ello le sea razonablemente solicitado por la Empresa.

Asimismo, el Artista se obliga a realizar al menos una (1) publicación promocional relativa a la Obra Audiovisual en su(s) cuenta(s) principal(es) de redes sociales con motivo del estreno oficial de la Obra Audiovisual, en la fecha o dentro del período que la Empresa indique razonablemente.

El Artista reconoce y acepta asimismo que todas las obligaciones promocionales previstas en la presente cláusula se encuentran comprendidas dentro de la remuneración pactada en el presente Contrato y no darán derecho al cobro de honorarios, compensaciones, reintegros ni pagos adicionales de ninguna naturaleza.

 

8.ACUERDO DE CONFIDENCIALIDAD, SECRETO PROFESIONAL Y PROPIEDAD:

La Información Privada incluye, sin limitación, los siguientes tipos de información y otra información de naturaleza similar (ya sea tangible o intangible y esté o no reducida a escrito): toda la información relacionada con la Obra Audiovisual y su producción y explotación, incluyendo, sin limitación, toda la información relacionada con el guion corto y el tratamiento, el guion largo y el tratamiento, el presupuesto, el calendario, los planos, los dibujos, los diseños, las especificaciones, las ideas, los conceptos, los modelos, el vestuario, las técnicas o los efectos especiales de la Obra Audiovisual u otros elementos creativos, comerciales y/o físicos de la producción relacionados con la Obra Audiovisual.

En consecuencia, el Artista acepta que, a menos y hasta que la Empresa o sus representantes autorizados lo autoricen expresamente por escrito, el Artista deberá: a) Mantener toda la Información Confidencial/Privada (ya sea relacionada con los servicios del Artista o de otro tipo que haya conocido el Artista) en la más estricta confidencialidad; b) No reproducirá ni duplicará ninguna información confidencial/privada (a menos que sea necesario para prestar servicios y, en tal caso, solo en la medida mínima necesaria); c) Devolverá cualquier información confidencial/privada que obre en su poder (y borrará cualquier información confidencial/privada duplicada en su disco duro o almacenada digitalmente, y proporcionará certificación de tales acciones) cuando la Empresa lo solicite; d) No divulgar, informar, revelar, difundir rumores o especular sobre, ceder, vender o transferir, ya sea directa o indirectamente, por cualquier medio, incluyendo, sin limitación, el correo electrónico, los blogs, Instagram o Twitter, ninguna información confidencial/privada a ninguna persona o empresa, con la excepción de otras personas que presten servicios en la Obra Audiovisual, pero solo si es necesario y en la medida en que sea necesario para que puedan prestar dichos servicios o evaluar una posible transacción (en conjunto, el «Personal autorizado»), siempre que se informe a dicho Personal autorizado de los requisitos de confidencialidad con respecto a la Información confidencial/privada y se acuerde la firma previa de una copia del presente Acuerdo por su parte.
